title: Scaling Vision Transformers to 22 Billion Parameters

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating demographic parity and accuracy disparities between male and female subgroups on the CelebA dataset when predicting attributes such as 'attractive' or 'smiling'.

Using the model-vs-human toolbox to measure the model's inductive bias, specifically its preference for relying on object shape versus texture in image classification tasks compared to human visual perception.
